faqs.question: What is an MBA in Family Business Management course all about?
faqs.answer: An MBA in Family Business Management is a specialized Master of Business Administration programme designed to equip individuals with the skills and knowledge necessary to effectively manage and lead family-owned businesses. Family businesses have unique dynamics and challenges compared to other types of enterprises, often involving complex interplay between family relationships, ownership structures, and business operations.

faqs.question: Is pursuing an MBA in Family Business Management worth it?
faqs.answer: Yes, an MBA in Family Business Management is worth it if you intend to work within your family business or aspire to take on leadership roles within it, an MBA in Family Business can provide valuable knowledge and skills tailored to the unique challenges of managing such enterprises. If you're already involved in the family business, an MBA in Family Business Management can equip you with a broader set of management skills that can be applied to various aspects of business operations, potentially leading to improved performance and competitiveness.

faqs.question: I am a B.Com graduate. Do I need to do an MBA in Family Business Management to expand my family business?
faqs.answer: While pursuing an MBA in Family Business Management is not necessary for the upliftment of one’s family business endeavours, however, the course can help in numerous ways. Whether you need to pursue an MBA in Family Business Management to expand your family's business depends on various factors, including your current skills, the specific needs of the business, and your long-term goals. Here are some considerations to help you make an informed decision: Understanding Family Dynamics: Family businesses often have complex dynamics that can affect decision-making, succession planning, and overall business strategy. Succession Planning: Succession planning is a critical aspect of family business management, ensuring a smooth transition of leadership and ownership from one generation to the next. Enhancing Leadership Skills: Effective leadership is essential for the success of any business, and family-owned enterprises are no exception. Access to Resources and Expertise: Many MBA programs have faculty members with expertise in family business management, as well as resources such as research centres, case studies, and industry partnerships focused on family-owned enterprises.

faqs.question: How important is work experience for admission to MBA in Family Business program?
faqs.answer: While work experience is not always mandatory, it can significantly enhance your profile and chances of admission. It demonstrates your practical understanding of business operations and your commitment to the family business.

blocks.value: MBA in Family Business programme is designed with an immersive and case-based learning approach that combines administrative, entrepreneurial, and technical abilities. The course expands the vision of the candidates and enhances their leadership and problem-solving skills required in the business world. It also encourages the qualities of a true leader within them. Students can pursue MBA in Family Business Management or Postgraduate Diploma in Family Business to meet their career objectives and business requirement.

MBA in Family Business Important Facts
The important points related to MBA in Family Business are given below:

Eligibility- Interested students must have graduated with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks from a recognised university or college. They must have submitted the required documentation and declarations in the approved manner regarding their knowledge of their family business. This programme is also offered to students in their final year of graduation.

Admission Process- On the basis of the documents presented by the interested students, applications are assessed and eligibility is determined. Eligible students also need to appear in the entrance tests held at the national or university levels and get good scores. They also need to appear in group discussions and personal interviews depending on the admission procedure followed by the colleges.

Who Should Attend- This programme is planned for entrepreneurs and those running family businesses. The participants of this course should be graduates and possess five years of work experience. If the participant is the owner of a business, the work experience criteria are relaxed.

Learnings- The desirous students will learn valuable entrepreneurship skills needed to run a respectable business. Also, it will help them in becoming potential leaders. It will also assist them in building strategic thinking, vision, and commercial acumen while improving their electronic information analysis ability.

Curriculum- The syllabus of the MBA in Family Business is divided into four semesters. In the first three semesters, students will gain in-depth knowledge about topics related to management and businesses, while in the fourth semester, students will go for an Industry internship/ Entrepreneurial Venture Foundation/Business Expansion.

MAT- The All India Management Association administers the Management Aptitude Test (MAT) , a national admissions exam for MBA/PGDM admissions (AIMA). AIMA conducts the admission exam in three modes: computer-based test , paper-based test, and internet-based test.

data: The CAT exam syllabus includes three subjects – Verbal Ability & Reading Comprehension (VARC), Data Interpretation & Logical Reasoning (DILR), and Quantitative Aptitude (QA) . The main topics of focus while covering the CAT syllabus are Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry, Percentages, Graphs, English Grammar, Coding-Decoding, Series Completion, etc.

MAT Syllabus includes Language Comprehension, Intelligence Critical Reasoning, Data Analysis and Sufficiency, Mathematical Skills, and Indian and Global Environment. The syllabus for MAT has been designed to check the candidate’s analytical skills, logical aptitude, English comprehension, and general awareness.
The XAT exam syllabus includes topics from Decision Making, Verbal & Logical Ability, Quantitative Ability & Data Interpretation, and General Knowledge.
CMAT Syllabus consists of five subjects – Quantitative Techniques & Data Interpretation, Logical Reasoning, Language Comprehension, General Awareness, and Innovation & Entrepreneurship.
SNAP syllabus includes topics from General English, Quantitative Ability, and Reasoning like other entrance exam syllabus.

5years.title: How to Get Admission in IIM after 12th?: Check IIM 5 year Integrated Courses, Eligibility, Fees, Entrance Exams

article_info.summary: If you plan to pursue MBA from IIM after Class 12 then you must read this article. Class 12 students can check here all about 5-yr IIM BBA MBA integrated course at IIM Rohtak, IIM Indore, IIM Jammu, IIM Ranchi, IIM Bodh Gaya. Get all the information about Integrated MBA in IIM including entrance exam, admission process, eligibility & more details.

complete_article.text: How to get admission inIIM after 12th?If you are looking for an answer to this question, read this article. The IIMs offer BBA MBA integrated course of 5-year after class 12. Admission at the IIM integrated course is based on entrance exam and personality assessment. Know all about 5-yearIntegrated MBA programme (IPM) offered by IIMsafter Class 12.

How to get admission in IIM after 12?if you are looking for an answer to this question, then you have reached the right place. IIM Integrated MBA programmes are becoming very popular among class 12 students who wish to make a career in the field of management. IIM Courses after 12th are offered by IIM Indore, IIM Rohtak, IIM Ranchi, IIM Jammu and IIM Bodh Gaya. They offer the Five-year Integrated MBA programme in full time mode. Candidates can puruse the IIM course after 12th,by appearing for the entrance exam. At the end of the IIM Integrated course candidates get MBA degree and campus placement.

IIM IndoreandIIM Rohtakhave been imparting the five-year integrated course in MBA for undergraduate students for a few years now. In 2021,IIM Ranchi,IIM JammuandIIM Bodh Gayaalso introduced IPM degree courses for students after Class 12. The IIM 5 year integrated course after 12th (Five Year Integrated Programme in Management (IPM), is a unique programme that aims to meet the aspirations of young students to become management professionals. You can go to IIM after 12th by clearing the entrance exam, Written Ability Test (WAT) and Personal Interview (PI). Know here all aboutIIM Integrated course after 12th.In this article, we have shared complete information about the IIM courses after 12th (IPM) of IM Indore, IIM Rohtak, IIM Ranchi, IIM Jammu and IIM Bodhgaya.
IIM Courses After 12th: Key Highlights
Before you read in detail abour IIM Integrated courses, here are some key highlights:
IIM Indore's Five Year Integrated MBA (IPM)

IIM Indore's Integrated Programme in Management has been accredited by the Association of MBAs (London). Admission to this IIM course after 12th is through a common entrance exam,Integrated Program in Management Aptitude Test or IPMAT.

The five-year Integrated course in Management (IIMBBA+MBAIntegrated course) is a 15-term program that is spread over five years with three terms a year. Each term is for three months. The course includes management education in the social sciences setting. Accordingly, 40 per cent of the programme would focus on subjects related to the following:
Mathematics, Statistics, Logic and Computer Science
Introduction to Literature and Political Science
Civilization and History (both national and international)
Exposure to biological sciences
Exposure to languages (one foreign language and one Indian language)
Soft skills: Leadership development, personality development, teamwork and communication both written and oral

The remaining 10 per cent of the IPM programme focuses on international exposure and internship in various social organizations in India. The second module - the remaining 50% of the course consists all functional areas of management such as:
Accounting
Finance
Organisational Behaviour
Decision Science
Operations and Services Management
Marketing
Economics
Information Technology
Communication
Legal Aspects of Business
Ethics
Corporate Governance
Corporate Social Responsibility
Business Strategy
International Business
Entrepreneurship
IIM Indore IPMATEligibility Criteria
Given below is the minimum eligibility criteria for IPMAT:
60 per cent aggregate at Secondary/Class 10 equivalent and at Higher Secondary/Class 12 equivalent for General candidates. For NC-OBC candidates the minimum aggregate required is 55 per cent.
Candidates in Class 12 are also eligible to apply for IPMAT
Candidate must not be above the age of 20 years
IIM Indore IPMATSelection Process
Selection of candidates for IIM Indore's five-year integrated course is done in three phases.
Phase 1: IPMAT exam
Phase 2: Shortlisting of candidates for Written Ability Test (WAT) and Personal Interview (PI)
Phase 3: Final selection of candidates on the basis of IPMAT score, WAT and PI
IPMAT 2025 Dates

Given below is the schedule ofIPMAT 2025and admission process. IPMAT 2025 exam was held on May 12, 2025. Candidates interested in appearing for the entrance exam had to fill theIPMAT 2025 application formbefore deadline.
Test Centres:Bangalore, Delhi, Hyderabad, Indore, Kolkata and Mumbai
IIPMAT Application Fees:INR 4,130 for General category candidates and INR 2,065 for SC/ST/PwD category candidates
IIM After 12thFees: IPM course fee

IIM BBA-MBA Integrated course fees for the first three years the course fee is INR 4,00,000 per annum for domestic candidates and INR 6,00,000 per annum for international students. The course fee for the fourth and fifth years would be as per the prevailing Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGP) fees.

IIM Rohtak Five Year Integrated MBA (IPM)

IIM Rohtak’s Integrated MBA programme is also called Five Year Integrated Programme in Management or IPM. The programme is taught in 3+2 mode. The first three years are divided into nine semesters and the last two years are taught as per the PGP programme curriculum. IIM Rohtak IPM course fee is INR 28,73,000.
IIM Rohtak 5-year Integrated Course in ManagementEligibility Criteria
The candidate must have a minimum score of 60 percent aggregate in Class 10 and 12. For SC/ST and PwD candidates, the minimum score requirement is 55 percent.
The candidate should not be more than 20 years
Candidates in class 12 who are awaiting their result are also eligible to apply
IIM admission process after 12th: IIM RohtakSelection Process
The selection process of IIM Rohtak Five-Year Integrated Course in Management has three phases:
Phase 1:IPM Aptitude Test 2025
Phase 2: Shortlisting of candidates for WAT and PI
Phase 3: Final selection of candidates on the basis of performance in IPM Aptitude Test, WAT and PI

IPM Aptitude Test 2025 Dates
Given below are thedates of IPM Aptitude Test 2025and further admission process. The IPM Aptitude Test 2025 or IPMAT Rohtak 2025 was conducted on May 6, 2025

Test centres:Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Chandigarh, Chennai, Dehradun, Ghaziabad, Gurugram, Guwahati, Gwalior, Hyderabad, Indore, Jaipur, Kolkata, Kozhikode, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, New Delhi, Noida, Patna, Pune, Raipur, Ranchi, Thiruvananthapuram, Varanasi and Visakhapatnam.
IPMAT Rohtak Fees:INR 4500 to be submitted online along with the application form.
IPMAT Rohtak Exam Pattern
IPM Aptitude Test will assess the candidate’s analytical and verbal skills. Check the section-wise break-up of the question paper andIPM Aptitude Test Patternbelow.
Incase, a candidate also selects Integrated Programme in Law, they will have to appear for fourth section - Legal Reasoning which will have 20 questions to be solved in 20 minutes.
IIM Ranchi Integrated Programme in Management (IPM)

The IPM offered byIIM Ranchiis a full-time 5-year management programme introduced in the 2023 academic year. The first batch of IIM Ranchi IPM had 120 students. Admission process is through IPMAT conducted by IIM Indore and the programme commences in September. Know all about the IPM below:
IIM Ranchi IPM Eligibility Criteria
Candidates should have a minimum of 60 per cent aggregate or equivalent in Class 10 and 12 (55 per cent for candidates from SC/ST/PwD)
There is no age limit for candidates
Indian Nationals and PIO/OCI Card Holders are eligible to apply for IPM
IIM Ranchi IPM Admissions Process

Admission to the IPM 2025 of IIM Ranchi will be based on IPMAT 2025 exam scores, a Written Ability Test (WAT), Personal Interview (PI), and overall academic performance. WAT and PIs will be conducted at Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai, and Ranchi.
IIM Ranchi IPMApplication Process

The application process for IIM Ranchi IPM is through IPMAT registrations. Candidates can apply before or after they take the IPMAT 2025 exam. The application fee is INR 2,000 (INR 1,000 for reserved category students).
IIM Ranchi 5 Year Integrated Course Fees (IPM)

The IIM 5 year integrated course fees of IIM Ranchi is divided into BBA and MBA. The total fees for the first three years of the program will be around INR 14 lakh. The fees for the next two years will be same as that of MBA programme of IIM Ranchi.
IIM Jammu Integrated Programme in Management (IPM)

TheIIM JammuIntegrated Programme in Management was also launched in 2021. The first batch of IIM Jammu IPM had seat intake of 60. The selection of candidates for the course is done on the basis of Joint Integrated Programme in Management Admission Test (JIPMAT) to be conducted by National Testing Agency (NTA). More information on this entrance test is awaited. Know all about IIM Jammu IPM below:
IIM Jammu IPM Eligibility Criteria
The candidate must have passed Class 12/HSC or equivalent examination from a recognised university or education board
The candidate must have scored a minimum aggregate of 60 per cent or equivalent in Class 10 and 12 (55 per cent for the candidates from SC/ST/ PwD category)
Applicants pursuing Class 12 from international schools affiliated to foreign boards like International General Certificate for Secondary Education and International Baccalaureate can also apply
IIM admission process after 12th: IIM Jammu IPM

The IIM Jammu IPM admission process includesJoint Integrated Programme in Management Admission Test(JIPMAT), academic record evaluation. After the entrance exam, the institute will prepare merit list of students for selection on the basis of their score inJIPMATand academics. IIM Jammu IPM application process is online. TheJIPMAT 2025 formwas available at the institute and NTA websites. Candidates had to register and pay the exam fee to fill the JIPMAT form.Apply for JIPMAT 2025
IIM Bodh Gaya Integrated Programme in Management (IPM)

TheIIM Bodh Gaya’s Integrated Programme in Management is also a 5-year integrated MBA programme launched this year. Admission to this course will be throughJIPMATto be conducted by NTA. Know all about IIM Bodh Gaya IPM and JIPMAT below:
JIPMAT 2025: Important Dates
Given below is theschedule of JIPMAT 2025.The registrations were done from February 11, 2025 to March 10, 2025 and the exam was conducted on April 26, 2025.

The candidate must have passed Class 12/HSC or equivalent examination with a minimum aggregate of 60 per cent or equivalent in Class 10 and 12 (55 per cent for the candidates from SC/ST/ PwD category)
Applicants pursuing Class 12 from international schools affiliated to foreign boards are also eligible to apply
IIM Bodh Gaya IPM Admission Process
The IIM Bodh Gaya IPM Admission Process includes the entrance and Personal Interview (PI). To prepare the merit list, marks obtained inJIPMATand PI would be computed in the following ratio:
IIM Bodh Gaya IPM Admission Process
IIM Bodh Gaya IPM application process will be online. The forms will be available on the institute and NTA websites. Candidates can apply through JIPMAT registration.
IIM Bodh Gaya IPM Fees
The total fee of first three years of IPM will be INR 13.5 lakh. Tentative tuition fee for the fourth and fifth year would be as INR 7.5 lakh per year (equivalent PGP fee for batch).

No, IPMAT is conducted only once a year. Candidates have to wait for the next session if they miss this year's exam. The IPMAT exam is being conducted in the CBT (computer-based test) mode. Based on the IPM Aptitude Test scores, students can apply for admission to integrated management programme offered by the prestigious Indian Institute of Managment, Indore. The exam will only be conducted in the computer-based test mode for all the sessions across various cities. The difficulty level of the IPMAT exam is usually moderate and the candidates can easily prepare for this exam. Candidates who wish to appear for the IPMAT exam need to apply on the official website of IIM Indore and fill out the IPMAT application form once the application window opens. IPMAT is held in about 28 test cities across the country, and the students need to visit the exam centre in order to take the exam.

Yes, a 17 year old can give the IPMAT exam. The maximum age limit to be eligible to appear for the IPMAT Indore exam is 20 years as on July 31, of the given year. There is a relaxation in the age limit for the reserved category students. The candidates belonging to the General or NC-OBC category must be a maximum of 20 years and the students belonging to other reserved categories can be a maximum of 22 years in the admission year.
Including this, the students should also fulfil the academic IPMAT eligibility criteria to be able to take the IPMAT exam and IPM Admissions.
The answer to this question of whether an average student can get into IIM can be both yes and no depending on the definition of an average student.

Based on Academics (Class 10/ Class 12/ Graduation):While a student with average scores in Class 10, Class 12 and graduation with a good CAT score certainly has good chances of getting a call from IIM-A, chances are less for someone with an average CAT score.

Based on student category (General or Reserved):While it is tough for a General category average student to grab a seat at IIM due to high score requirements, a reserved category student can get admission being at average scores as well.

Based on past work experience, diversity and other factors:Gender and academic diversity is also a factor on which students are shortlisted at IIM. IIMs judge the past academic category based on the degree obtained by the students before MBA and then a weightage is allotted based on that. For Engineers, the percentage for scoring the highest marks is higher as compared with other streams

Performance in selection rounds:Once you make it to the final selection rounds, i.e., AWT/PI process, it can be considered a fresh start. At this stage, students can forget their past average-ness but definitely require good grasp over the past subjects as academics-related questions are asked in the interview.

Based on the above factors, it can be considered that while getting into top Management institutes, such as IIM is extremely tough, the past performance, CAT performance, student category and a lot of factors can be the reasons for a student to receive that final call.

Even if the candidate clears the sectional and overall cutoff in IPMAT exam but does not get shortlisted for the PI round, it means that the candidate is eligible but not among the top-ranked candidates based on the composite score. Such a candidate will not be considered for admission to the IPM programme.

Such candidates can opt for reappearing for the exam next year, as there is no provision of re-evaluation. Candidates can also consider applying to other institutes which accept IPMAT Indore scores, such as NIRMA University, TAPMI, etc.

For admission to MBA (or PGP) atIIM Bodh Gaya, the CAT test is usually conducted in November. Aspirants ofIIM Bodh Gayaare required to appear for the exam in Computer Based Testing mode at the allotted test centres. CAT exam is held in three slots:
Morning slot: 8:30 AM to 10:30 AM
Afternoon slot: 12:30 PM to 2:30 PM
Evening slot: 4:30 PM to 6:30 PM

Every year over 18000 students appear for the IPMAT exam conducted by the prestigious IIM Indore. In 2025, it is anticipated that about 30,000 students appeared for the IPMAT exam. In 2022, over 18000 students appeared for the exam and the number has been rising since. Check here the year-wise numbers of IPMAT applicants:
2024- 28,596 students
2023- 22,000 students
2022- 18,000 students
2021- About 15,000 students

questions.question_text: Is it a good idea to give multiple MBA entrance exams like CAT CMAT XAT MAT?
questions.answer_text: Yes, giving multiple MBA entrance exams like CAT, CMAT, XAT, and MAT is generally a good idea. Most of the syllabus overlaps, so your preparation works across exams, and it reduces the risk of depending on just one test.Different exams open doors to different colleges. For example, CAT is needed for IIMs, while exams like CMAT, MAT, or NMAT are accepted by many private B-schools. Colleges such as Athena School of Management also consider multiple exams and focus on the overall profile, so having more scores gives you flexibility.Overall, multiple exams simply mean more options and backup choices, which is always helpful.

questions.question_text: Is quality of MBA education declining?
questions.answer_text: I don't think the quality of MBA education is declining overall, but it's becoming very uneven. A lot more colleges have opened in the last few years, so the quality really depends on the institute you choose.Top and mid-tier B-schools still maintain good faculty, internships and placement support. But some smaller colleges don't update their curriculum or offer enough industry exposure, which makes the experience feel outdated.So it's not that MBA quality is falling everywhere — it's just important to pick a college that focuses on practical learning, internships and industry linkages rather than just classroom teaching.
